changes: Name changed from 'Dharmaśarman' to 'Dharma': 'śarman' is a brahmin suffix, so it now goes in titles
Weekday 'roja 7' now read as Saturday (śanivāra), the 7th day of the week
Notes now explain that 'jyeṣṭha 23' is the solar day of the month (gate)

date.as_written: samvat 1983 sāla jyeṣṭha 23 roja 7 kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyāṃ tithau

notes: The era is not named, but 'samvat 1983 sāla' with a solar day count ('jyeṣṭha 23', i.e. the 23rd solar day of Jyeṣṭha) and 'roja 7' (Saturday) fits Vikrama Saṃvat in 20th-century Nepal. That gives May–June 1926 CE. The scribe's name 'dharmaśa(r)mma' is written uninflected and in a corrupt form, for Dharma Śarmā. The colophon calls the text 'kātyāyanītantroktaprayogavidhiḥ', while the catalogue title is 'Mantraprayogavidhi'.
